description: AlphaFold pLDDT and burial of the ADPRHL1 N-terminus
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

j=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q8NDY3",timeout=90)
print(j.status_code)
d=j.json()[0]
print({k:d[k] for k in d if 'Url' in k or k in ('entryId','latestVersion','uniprotStart','uniprotEnd')})
pdb=requests.get(d['pdbUrl'],timeout=90).text
print("lines:",len(pdb.splitlines()))
ca={}
for ln in pdb.splitlines():
    if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        ca[int(ln[22:26])]=((float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])), float(ln[60:66]))
resis=sorted(ca); plddt=np.array([ca[i][1] for i in resis]); coords=np.array([ca[i][0] for i in resis])
print("residues:",len(resis),"mean pLDDT %.1f"%plddt.mean())
print("pLDDT 1-20:",np.round(plddt[:20],1).tolist())
print("mean pLDDT res 1-13: %.1f | res 14-354: %.1f"%(plddt[:13].mean(),plddt[13:].mean()))
D=np.linalg.norm(coords[:,None,:]-coords[None,:,:],axis=-1); nb=(D<10).sum(1)-1
print("median CA neighbours: res1-13 %.0f | res14+ %.0f"%(np.median(nb[:13]),np.median(nb[13:])))
print("neighbours 1-15:",nb[:15].tolist())
d4=np.linalg.norm(coords[4:]-coords[:-4],axis=1)
print("i,i+4 CA distances res1-20 (helix ~6.2 A):",np.round(d4[:20],1).tolist())
globals().update(dict(PLDDT=plddt,NB=nb,RESIS=resis))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4))
ax[0].plot(resis,plddt,color='#2F6DB5',lw=1.2); ax[0].axvspan(1,13,color='#C4553B',alpha=.18)
ax[0].axhline(70,ls='--',c='grey',lw=1); ax[0].set_xlabel('Residue'); ax[0].set_ylabel('pLDDT')
ax[0].set_title('AlphaFold Q8NDY3: N-terminus is ordered (pLDDT %.0f for res 1-13),\nnot a disordered cleavable presequence'%plddt[:13].mean(),fontsize=10)
ax[1].plot(resis,nb,color='#2E9E7E',lw=1.0); ax[1].axvspan(1,13,color='#C4553B',alpha=.18)
ax[1].set_xlabel('Residue'); ax[1].set_ylabel('CA neighbours within 10 A')
ax[1].set_title('Residues 1-13 pack against the ARH fold',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
